verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a self-hostable search engine. No first-party evidence documents a flag, setting, or environment variable to disable telemetry or usage tracking. The only on-topic item (meilisearch-comm-13) says analytics with a unique identifier is on by default, but it does not describe any opt-out mechanism. The analytics docs describe a customer-facing search-analytics feature, which is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
